canonical_name: Hilbert basis theorem for one polynomial indeterminate over a commutative Noetherian ring
literal_source_claim_zh: 诺特环上的多项式环仍是诺特环
literal_source_claim_en: A polynomial ring over a Noetherian ring is still Noetherian.
canonical_statement: For every commutative ring R, if R is Noetherian, then the univariate polynomial ring R[X] is Noetherian.
canonical_claim: For every commutative ring R, if every ideal of R is finitely generated, then every ideal of the univariate polynomial ring R[X] is finitely generated.
statement_blocker: Master acceptance of this self-tested exact conventional repository target is pending. Pinpoint historical source fidelity remains open on H and prevents any H0/source-fidelity claim, but not exact elaboration of the catalog-selected conventional scope.
